commitLines.line: 🛡️ Dmitri, Elif, Clinton step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Dmitri, Elif, Clinton march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 9 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
